change_from_v1: Same protocol as results/monday_nested_banks_v1/PROTOCOL.json with Amendments A1 and A2 built in, plus two banks: N40 = N22 + the 18 history-spectral channels that formed the old 32/35-channel bank (raw, not sign-flipped; label-free orientation is handled by the DS filter and by the oriented plain-average control), and N43 = N40 + 3 digit channels. Chains: N11 < N13 < N22 < N40 < N53 and N14 < N16 < N25 < N43 < N56. N40/N43 are appended at the end of the bank list so the other banks keep their TCI seeds; N53 keeps v1's channel order.
